    S = 512
    B = 8
    dtype = x.dtype
    
    # Initial all-reduce
    s = xm.all_reduce(xm.REDUCE_SUM, x)
    
    # Create two buffers for pipelining

    # Process 8 iterations in pairs using dual buffers
